about.title: About
about.intro: I am Domenico Futia, a student and researcher working on philosophy of mind, the enactive approach, phenomenology, and narrative identity.
about.body: My work sits at the intersection of philosophical reflection, cognitive science, critical writing, and front-end development. This portfolio gathers my path, research interests, and editorial and digital projects.

resume.title: Resume and background
resume.intro: Philosophy student and worker in the tourism sector. Combining the analytical approach of humanistic studies with pragmatism developed in the field, I tackle daily challenges with a broad vision, mental flexibility, and a rapid learning ability.

experience.description: Supporting tourist guides during group excursions between Pisa and Florence. Assisting international visitors and people with specific needs; managing technical equipment and taking photographs for tourists.
Weekly study support sessions for students enrolled in 'Introduction to Philosophy of Mind'. Clarifying theoretical concepts and providing in-depth insights to support exam preparation.

education.degree: Master's Degree in Philosophy and Forms of Knowledge
education.description: Focus on Identity, Consciousness, and Philosophy of Mind.
Courses in Philosophy, Transcultural Studies, and German.
Graduated with honors (110/110 cum laude). Thesis: "Bodily Self and Narrative Identity. Ricœur in Dialogue with Enactivism".

education.degree: High School Diploma – Social and Economic Sciences
education.description: Graduated with honors (100/100 cum laude). Student representative at the Provincial Student Council and Internal Guarantee Body. Active participation in various school projects.
